profile.headline: Software Engineer at Broadcom
profile.summary:
Datacenter Cloud and storage Architect: CCIE , CCNP, CCNA, VCP, Storage Specialist
A versatile and skilled datacenter cloud architect with strong leadership and excellent hands-on experience in virtualization and cloud area. Outstanding interpersonal, communications, negotiation , people management and technical skills.

positions.title: Sr. Technical Leader for ACI Solution
positions.description:
Escalation engineer for cisco software define network solutions. ACI
Scale QA testing for L4-L7 feature

positions.title: Sr. Technical Leader UCS
positions.description:
*Working, implementing and trouble shooting cloud/virtualized datacenter environment, such as openstack, ucs director, v cloud director, and hadoop deployment. 

*Working closely with cross functional team, such as Development/QA/marketing and other vendor development team to troubleshoot and recreate complex issues on OS/Server/BIOS/Option ROM/Chassis Hardware/SAN/LAN/Storage/Network and UCSM

* Build, mentor and facilitate the team to work with multiple cross-functional team to handle very complex problems. 
* Recreate the complex environment for complex problems and root causing along with engineering. Also looking for quick solution and workaround for customer and 
* Transfer knowledge and train the customer support in a formal training class and write documents 
* Leading the weekly meeting with multiple teams to facilitate the collaboration and knowledge transfer. 
* Improving product quality and serviceability with Engineering team by addressing and prioritizing internal and external defects and also work with marking and engineering to reprioritize new feature requests.
* Provide TOI to different functional team and work with Documentation team to fix and write new configuration guides 
* Coordinating and collaborating with QA team for test cases and regression test 
* Partnering with other technical vendors such as Vmware/EMC, HP to effectively trouble shoot complex friendly or non-friendly multivendor issues for customer.
* Engage and collaborate with account team and service team to provide smooth hand over from re-active to pro-active to improve customer experience

*I have in depth expertise in various LAN, SAN, data center networking, virtual nic, virtualization cloud automation/orchestration solutions (VMWare vCenter/vCO, vCloud Director, Openstack, UCS director etc).

positions.description:

Unified Computing System, Nexus, Virtualization Technology.

positions.title: Project Coordinator
positions.description:
-State's main public health care system 
-Strategic consulting, including long and short term IT network plan
- Develop new solutions for enterprise network group and campus users.
- Mentoring and training Jr. engineers.

positions.title: Network Lead Engineer
positions.description:
-Promote network consulting, hosting and e-business and managing the projects.
-Manage network engineers, customers and project implementations. 
-Brand development, web site traffic growth, web site UI and advertising revenue. Developed brand strategy and statistics systems.
-Strategic Consulting, including business plan & sales strategy development.

positions.title: Network Admin/System Admin
positions.description: As a network admin, I was responsible to run all web application systems and internetwork and security. This included web application QA testing after finished development.
